name: Fibonacci Bento
description: Framed media bento on a Fibonacci-style 5-card grid. Dark frame, hover overlays tint cards with the brand color, titles thicken, and the heading letters rise in one by one.
interactions: heading splits into letters, staggered translateY(110%) rise on first view (18ms/letter)
per-letter hover pop animation with reflow restart
card hover: overlay tints with btn-bg-enable multiply + backdrop blur, description fades up
title weight transitions 700 -> 900 via font-variation-settings on hover
frame shadow softens on grid hover
prefers-reduced-motion: all reveals and transitions disabled
